notes.title: News about "Beach Episode DLC"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/008d134b9a2f29a93ccd39f37288bdc9d3af02ac.png[/img]

[h3][b]It’s still winter, but you already want to chill out on the beach? Then these news are for you![/b][/h3]

[i]“Beach Episode” - a spin-off DLC[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3283090/MILFs_Plaza__Beach_Episode

For many months, Mary was dying from her work from home, Christie was dying from boredom even with a book in her hand, and Kat was still working in the restaurant - and for what? To take a big breather, of course! And we only want to help a little, with a ticket to a beautiful lakeside beach. Under the sweltering sun and the shadows of gorgeous women’s silhouettes.

Of course, there will be other girls on this tourist site. Both us and the MC have to get ready for it. Stock up on sun cream, swimming trunks and make sure your inflatable ring does not deflate. We, in turn, will make sure to finish the DLC in time.

“Beach Episode” will have a complex location with many activities. The event is repeatable, so you can go there every weekend:
- 4 new locations;
- 5 familiar beauties ready for anything;
- 6+ animated scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/408c702bc205bd52f6681a97edd5fcb5a3085ab7.jpg[/img]

I’ve decided to make this event continuous and memorable. Most games chalk this event to the phrase “Let’s go!” - and here we are on the resort, having fun in the sea and applying sun cream to beautiful women. I don’t want the easy way out.

First, there’s a plot hook. A small quest, with the beach as the main reward.

The resort is a complex region made from several locations. I don’t know if timeskips make sense here yet. The plot I’m writing doesn’t take it into account. But there’s several familiar mini-games and a new one. I’m more busy with writing than art right now, so I’m sorry if I don’t have much to show. In the next five days, I’ll complete the design document for layout and dive into illustrating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/e7a9852af422d8ea765cf622b3b2fb905eaa3cd3.jpg[/img]

As I’ve said before, I’ve tasked the animator to animate earlier static scenes so that you won’t be bored in the meantime. Do you remember your night visits to Marisha? The shower peeping? Yeah! It only had two static shots per episode. Now it has full-on animation. We’re working on animating seven scenes in this way. Have a nice weekend :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/ed488401c127227702f8b9518040eed6a7994e1b.png[/img]

[h2]Also, there’s a discount going on on Steam from 17th to 31st of January! Buy my game, and all additional content 25% off, and buy Bonus Content 60% off![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40904/MILFs_Plaza__GigaChad_Edition

[h2]And don’t forget about the bundle with my publisher’s games:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40941/TopHouse_Games_Bundle

notes.content:

notes.title: MILF’s Plaza - News #09/27/2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/a4610ee2a5ea42f856362ad170d26cad1f6988c3.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Some good timeless news! Plans, hopes, expectations.[/b][/h3]

Right to the point. After finishing the litigation over Nancy's (Librarian) long-suffering root in terms of introducing root into the game code, we are now adding localizations to the root (as well as to some other parts of the game that didn't have it) so that this time it will be bug-free. I'll also try to fix the achievements, more precisely my new coder. Release is expected in October 2024 (NO EXACT DATES), when everything will be perfectly licked.

I also systematically moved on to the remaining gestalts to close all questions, as it were. Now it was the turn of Susan, our unforgettable psychologist. If you remember, our last meeting with her was interrupted by Christy, who literally snatched us from her deadly embrace. But what happened to Susan? How did her husband react in the aftermath? You'll find all of this out in the free update, which I HOPE you'll be able to get your hands on as early as next month (I also can't promise 100% about dates). Among other things, there will be a small, repetitive event about the same character. The release will also be in October, or a bit later as the update is fine-tuned.

Next on the plan is an out of story DLC. Total fanservice. A little absurdity, a little romance, a little euphoria in the company of your favorite women characters. I've been dreaming up this idea for a long time, and I'll be happy to entertain you with a new update on the eve of the winter holidays. The deadline is December 2024. If I don't shit myself, of course.

Right after New Year's Eve, I'll be getting to work on Kat. She, as you can imagine, can't end her existence just lying on the couch. Why can't she sleep at night? What are her plans? We'll find out.

I'm also thinking about Miswanda. Well, you're thinking about her. And I still don't know why the fuck you're thinking about her. Miswanda's made it clear that she doesn't want a relationship with a protagonist who's clearly involved in crime. Even after coming over to the “light” side, problems still haunt our guy, and Mishwanda is a serious girl, and she has no intention of building a relationship with the asshole. What do you expect from Mishwanda? I honestly don't understand. Purely out of love for you guys, I could have done a couple more scenes where she let's you touch her and tells you to fuck off again, making it even more affirmative that her story is ENDED and I can finally sit down for MILF's Plaza 2.

[h2][b]Your Texic[/b][/h2]

notes.title: RELEASE - MILF’s Plaza on Steam 🥳
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/6a8e113f0df5dd9f365a5178a89a7f103fe4c388.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Have a great day, our dear players![/b][/h3]
[b]Today is our SIGNIFICANT DAY![/b] It's the first time you have a game branded by us - [b]TopHouse Publishing[/b] on your screen! This news is so happy, so our friend's project - [u][b]MILF's Plaza by Texic[/b][/u] - will be the first one! The game is already released on Steam and is available in 13 languages 🧡 [I]So let's go, let's go![/I]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706300/MILFs_Plaza

[b]MILF's Plaza[/b] is an erotic visual novel with a non-linear plot in a unique 2D style! The main character, full of ambition and eager for thrills, is ready to do anything to find his place in the sun. But his life is only turning out to be more complicated…

[b]About the game:[/b]
[list][*] More than 50 animated NSFW scenes and erotic cards
[*] 4 root girls and a some secondary ones too
[*] Open world and different mechanics (battles, mini-games)
[*] Opportunity to play in story or survival mode
[*] Languages: English, Russian, French, German, Spanish LatAm, Portuguese Br, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Japanese, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional [i](p.s. if your language shows Russian or English in the game, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2706300/discussions/0/4368004047827449847/][u]please let us know about the bugs[/u][/url], we will correct it as soon as possible)[/i][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/426d56c806015d4ce42d995daa950da5490367c6.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]★ Dynamic narrative ★[/b][/h3]
The plot is intended to enthrall and entertain. The dialogues are full of irony and references, and the scenes themselves are short and varied. All this is framed in a marvellous art style with plenty of emotional sprites, art inserts, animation and mini-games. An interactive novel in all its glory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/a64189512d63e8679938e13e0acc79f55e0ddee9.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]★ Charming characters ★[/b][/h3]
The game is abundant with female characters, most of whom you can have a short or full-fledged romance with, drowning in the number of intimate scenes. Mary and Christy are the main characters, the completion of whose story not only doesn't end the game, but also unlocks new content: additional events, characters, quests and costumes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/043f0e80a6627afd1f9783c98dcef261e1eed2c1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/a241f4b984cfd4593f576e42d233eb44faa28964.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/c440516a9ba4999616947c2d580d8e81027fb29e.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]★ Sandbox ★[/b][/h3]
The gameplay has virtually no restrictions on your freedom of action and movement. With few exceptions, you are free to have affairs with whomever and whenever you want. For those who are particularly tempted by the genre, there is a "Survival" mode in the game, in which you need to sleep, eat and rest. And in general, it makes the gameplay more diverse and immerses you in the world of beautiful maidens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774059/765a86a11c0ba7a63fa86c596d35504d246d58d0.jpg[/img]
